context: Two close friends catch up over coffee about work life
purpose: Teach: 両者/筋肉/同僚/起こり/余計/ふたり/看板/椅子

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: ひさしぶり！ふたりでゆっくり話すの、何ヶ月ぶりかな。
lines.en: It's been forever! How many months since we two just sat and talked properly?
lines.style: Warm and slightly nostalgic, soft delivery between close friends reuniting after a long time.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: ほんとに。お店の看板を新しくしてから、毎日バタバタで余計に時間がなくてさ。
lines.en: Right? Ever since we redid the shop sign, every day's been chaos and time feels even tighter.
lines.style: Casual and a bit weary, friendly barista venting comfortably to an old friend.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: わかる。私のほうも同僚と小さな揉めごとが起こりかけて、ずっと胃が痛かったの。
lines.en: I get it. On my end a little dispute almost broke out with a coworker, and my stomach hurt for days.
lines.style: Softly confiding, slightly tired tone sharing a personal struggle with a trusted friend.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うわ、つらいね。両者にそれぞれ言い分があると、本当にこじれるよね。
lines.en: Ugh, that's rough. When both parties each have their own reasons, things really get tangled up.
lines.style: Sympathetic and grounded, offering understanding without being preachy or dramatic.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: そうなの。なんとか落ち着いたけど、まだ気持ちの整理がついてなくて。
lines.en: Exactly. It settled down somehow, but I still haven't sorted out my feelings about it.
lines.style: Reflective and a touch vulnerable, letting the heavier topic breathe before moving on.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 無理しないでね。気分転換も大事だよ、最近なにか始めたりした？
lines.en: Don't push yourself. A change of pace matters too — have you started anything new lately?
lines.style: Caring pivot from heavy topic, gentle barista curiosity inviting a lighter subject.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 実はジムに通い始めたの。でも筋肉痛がひどくて、椅子から立つのも一苦労だよ。
lines.en: Actually, I started going to the gym. But the muscle soreness is awful — even getting up from a chair is a struggle.
lines.style: Light-hearted complaint with a self-deprecating laugh, shifting the mood lighter intentionally.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: あはは、想像つく。今度お店終わったら、ごほうびに一杯おごるよ。
lines.en: Haha, I can picture it. Next time after the shop closes, I'll buy you a drink as a reward.
lines.style: Bright and affectionate, generous offer delivered with cheerful barista warmth.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: ありがとう、親切すぎる。先月もごちそうになったし、今日は私が払うね。
lines.en: Thank you, you're too kind. You treated me last month too, so today it's on me.
lines.style: Grateful and gently insistent, closing the loop on shared affection between friends.
